props.name: title
props.description: Bold lead-in before the message, e.g. "New".

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, e.g. a lucide icon.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing controls, e.g. a link or button.

props.name: motion
props.description: `static` shows the message in place. `ticker` scrolls `items` (or `children`) past in an endless loop, like a stock ticker.

props.name: items
props.description: Ticker segments. Falls back to `children` as a single segment.

props.name: speed
props.description: Ticker speed in pixels per second.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Scrolls the ticker the other way.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Holds the ticker still while it is hovered or focused.

props.name: strategy
props.description: Floating only. `fixed` pins to the viewport, `absolute` to the nearest positioned ancestor.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button; the banner hides itself when it is pressed.

examples.title: motion ticker · news, reverse
examples.setup:
const news = [
  "Payroll closes Thursday at 5pm",
  "New timesheet export is live",
  "Office closed Monday for the holiday",
]
examples.code:
<Banner
  motion="ticker"
  tone="broadcast"
  icon={<MegaphoneIcon />}
  items={news}
  speed={40}
  reverse
/>

examples.title: appearance solid
examples.code: {tones.map((tone) => ( Hours posted for Monday. ))}

examples.title: inline · announcement
examples.code:
<Banner
  tone="broadcast"
  icon={<MegaphoneIcon />}
  title="Office closed Friday"
  dismissible
>
  Submit hours by Thursday.
</Banner>

examples.title: floating · ticker left / right
examples.setup:
const quotes = [ ACME ▲ 2.41% , GLOBEX ▼ 0.87% , INITECH ▲ 1.12% , UMBRELLA ▼ 3.05% , HOOLI ▲ 0.34% , ] const news = [ "Payroll closes Thursday at 5pm", "New timesheet export is live", "Office closed Monday for the holiday", ] function Stage({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) { return (
{children}
) }
examples.code:
<Stage>
  <Banner
    layout="floating"
    strategy="absolute"
    position="left"
    motion="ticker"
    size="sm"
    appearance="solid"
    items={quotes}
  />
  <Banner
    layout="floating"
    strategy="absolute"
    position="right"
    motion="ticker"
    size="sm"
    tone="info"
    items={news}
  />
</Stage>
